notes: Total 60 as published. 'Starting Stuff (8)': the Objective, Alderaan, Death Star, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Prepared Defenses, Oppressive Enforcement, Mobilization Points and Planetary Subjugation. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

The published title 'Raphael @#$%elin - Again original and creative' is DeckTech's word filter turning the 'Ass' in Asselin into '@#$%'; dest_title 'Raphael Asselin Again original and creative' gives a clean page title. The post signs off 'Raphael @#$%elin, 1996 SWCCG World Champion' (existing page Raphael Asselin).

Posted 'Set your course for alderaan' dested Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe; 'Shorth Range Fighter' Short-range Fighters; 'Dreadnaught' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'Ghhhhkk' Ghhhk; 'There be hell to pay' There'll Be Hell To Pay; 'Mobilisation point' Mobilization Points; 'Intruder missiles' Intruder Missile; 'Kashyyk' Kashyyyk. Oppressive Enforcement is the Special Edition Effect in 2000 (not the Reflections III Defensive Shield).

The post's update (Death Star Assault Squadron and a Twi'lek Advisor out for 2 Darth Vader With Lightsaber; an All Power To Weapons out for Merrejk; an Overload out for There Is No Try) is not applied; dested as posted. The strategy also mentions a 'grabber' that is not in the list.
